newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rebhold listing attracts heavy interest.
newsitem.headline: Rebhold listing attracts heavy interest.

text.p: The listing of South African liquor, food and freight-forwarding firm Rebhold Ltd attracted heavy market interest on Wednesday after the new shares were eagerly snapped up by investors.
The firm said a private placing of 23 million shares had been fully subscribed and more than 1.1 million shares had changed hands by 0910 GMT.
The price was last at 258 cents having touched a high of 264.
"The public did not get much of a sniff at that offer. That's what is creating all the demand," one dealar said.
Dealers also pointed to a bullish profit forecast from the group. "They seem confident going forward," one said.
The firm said its earnings are forecast to grow at least 20 percent to 20.5 cents a share in the year to end-June, 1997, from 17.1 cents a share in the same period this year.
The company intends to adopt a dividend policy of 3.3 times cover.
